title: Resolved SED modelling with JWST and ALMA: the role of stellar mass surface density in regulating star formation in cosmic noon galaxies
comment: 26 pages, 15 figures, 5 tables. Published in MNRAS
summary: We present kpc-scale ($0.2''-0.5''$) physical property maps of 35 main-sequence galaxies at $z \approx 0.5-3.7$, with stellar masses of $\log(M_*/M_\odot) \sim 9.7-11.7$ and star formation rates of $\mathrm{SFR} \sim 1.4-280\,\mathrm{M_\odot\,yr^{-1}}$, selected from the ALMA Spectroscopic Survey (ASPECS) in the Hubble Ultra Deep Field. Leveraging the unique HST, JWST (NIRCam and MIRI), and ALMA observations, we perform spatially resolved spectral energy distribution (SED) modeling across the UV-to-FIR regime. We find that incorporating MIRI and/or ALMA data reduces the overestimation of dust luminosity (by up to $\sim0.8$ dex), while ALMA observations further mitigate the age-dust degeneracy. In the absence of such data, restricting the SED model library based on the observed unresolved colors can partially mitigate these biases. The stellar masses ($M_{*}$) derived from resolved and unresolved modeling are consistent within $\sim0.05$ dex, suggesting that mass discrepancies (attributed to outshining) are less significant for cosmic noon main-sequence galaxies when rest-frame near-infrared (NIR; e.g., $\sim1-3\,μ\mathrm{m}$) data are included. After normalization to the same reference, the composite SED of our sample closely resembles that of local starburst galaxies such as M82, suggesting similar dust attenuation and re-emission properties. Finally, we find that the molecular gas fraction and depletion time correlate with the effective stellar mass surface density ($Σ_{\rm eff,*} = M_{*}/2πR_{\rm eff,M_*}^2$) similarly to that observed in local galaxies. These results provide a first qualitative view of how the stellar gravitational potential influences gas regulation and star formation in galaxies beyond the local Universe.

title: SQuIGGLE: Radio AGN Found Predominantly in Young, Gas-rich Post-starburst Galaxies at z ~ 0.7
comment: 21 pages, 11 figures, submitted to ApJ. Comments welcome!
summary: The processes that rapidly quench massive galaxies and maintain their quiescence remain poorly understood. Substantial molecular gas reservoirs can survive this shutdown in post-starburst galaxies, raising the question of what prevents the remaining gas from efficiently forming stars. We present deep, subarcsecond VLA 6 GHz observations of 52 massive SQuIGGLE post-starburst galaxies at $z\sim0.7$ to test the prevalence and mechanical impact of radio activity during the gas-rich post-burst phase. We detect 6 GHz continuum emission in 18/52 galaxies ($\approx$35\%), spanning $\log(L_{1.4\,{\rm GHz}}/{\rm W\,Hz^{-1}})\simeq23.0$--$25.0$ and generally exceeding the contributions expected from ongoing star formation and the fading starburst, favoring an AGN origin. Ancillary data at other wavelengths provide little evidence for a population of luminous, radiatively efficient AGN, suggesting that these sources are instead dominated by comparatively weak, mechanically powered radio AGN. Radio activity is strongly concentrated within the first $\sim$200 Myr post-burst and is predominantly associated with galaxies retaining substantial gas reservoirs. Above a common radio luminosity threshold, the radio detection fraction is enhanced by a factor of $\approx$2.5 relative to the radio AGN candidate fraction in mass- and redshift-matched quiescent LEGA-C galaxies, primarily due to lower power sources. For efficient jet--ISM coupling, the inferred mechanical power could supply the approximate energy required to unbind the molecular gas on timescales comparable to its observed decline. Together, these results identify a population of radiatively inefficient AGN hosted predominantly by young, gas-rich post-starburst galaxies at $z\sim0.7$ and suggest that they may have a role in maintaining inefficient star formation.

artifacts.abstract_zh: 快速淬灭大质量星系并维持其静止状态的过程仍未被充分理解。在post-starburst星系中，大量的分子气体储库可以在这种关闭过程中存活下来，这引发了一个问题：是什么阻止了剩余气体高效地形成恒星。我们对52个位于$z\sim0.7$的大质量SQuIGGLE post-starburst星系进行了深度、亚角秒级的VLA 6 GHz观测，以检验在富气体的post-burst阶段射电活动的普遍性和机械影响。我们在18/52个星系中探测到6 GHz连续谱发射（$\approx$35\%），其范围跨越$\log(L_{1.4\,{\rm GHz}}/{\rm W\,Hz^{-1}})\simeq23.0$--$25.0$，并且通常超过正在进行的恒星形成和衰减的starburst所预期的贡献，这支持AGN起源。其他波段的辅助数据几乎没有提供证据表明存在一个明亮的、辐射高效的AGN群体，这表明这些源反而主要由相对较弱的、机械能驱动的射电AGN主导。射电活动强烈集中在post-burst后的最初$\sim$200 Myr内，并且主要与保留了大量气体储库的星系相关。在一个共同的射电光度阈值以上，射电探测分数相对于质量和红移匹配的静止LEGA-C星系中的射电AGN候选者分数提高了约2.5倍，这主要是由于较低功率的源。对于高效的喷流--星际介质耦合，推断的机械功率可以在与其观测到的下降相当的时间尺度上提供将分子气体解除束缚所需的大致能量。总之，这些结果识别出一类辐射效率低的AGN，它们主要寄宿于$z\sim0.7$的年轻、富气体的post-starburst星系中，并表明它们可能在维持低效恒星形成中发挥作用。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于可用摘要：研究识别出一类辐射效率低的AGN，主要寄宿于z~0.7年轻、富气体的post-starburst星系中，并可能参与维持低效恒星形成。

title: Galactic Outflows and Star-Formation Quenching: A JWST Perspective
comment: To be published as an invited review in the Astrophysics & Space Science 2025 Astronomy Prize Awardees Collection
summary: Outflows driven by active galactic nuclei (AGN) are widely considered a key mechanism for regulating and quenching star formation in massive galaxies. However, direct observational evidence linking outflows to quenching has remained elusive for decades. This article reviews recent findings for massive galaxies at cosmic noon ($z\sim 2$), based on sensitive James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) observations tracing both star formation histories (through Balmer absorption lines) and neutral outflows (through blueshifted NaID absorption). Neutral outflows are found in $\sim$ 25 - 50% of massive ($\log(M_*/M_\odot)>$ 10) galaxies, independent of star formation rate. Outflows from star-forming galaxies are consistent with being powered by star-formation and/or AGN activity, whereas outflows from quiescent systems are generally attributed to current or previous AGN activity. There is growing evidence that recent rapid quenching of star-formation is associated with powerful AGN-driven outflows with mass loading factors $η\gtrsim$ 1 - 10. The neutral gas dominates the outflow mass budget but in most cases its velocity is below the halo escape velocity, indicating that this gas may form part of a galactic fountain. Detections of neutral gas inflows and residual cold gas reservoirs in quiescent galaxies suggest that other feedback mechanisms such as AGN heating are required to keep galaxies quenched over long timescales. We highlight the potential of multiphase outflow measurements to constrain feedback models, describe the main systematic uncertainties in mass outflow rate measurements, and discuss how the $z\sim 2$ results inform our understanding of the formation of the earliest massive quiescent galaxies.

figures.caption_en: Figure 1: Strengths and weaknesses of outflow tracers commonly used at cosmic noon (top). The differences between emission line and absorption line tracers are illustrated using zoom-ins of an example \(z\sim\) 2 galaxy spectrum (bottom; Davies et al., in prep). Broad optical emission line components tracing ionized outflows are detected in many galaxies at cosmic noon, but they do not trace the dominant outflow phase and often are not sensitive to outflows in low mass galaxies because they blend with the much stronger ISM emission. CO outflows are normally only detected in the brightest systems. UV absorption lines require a bright rest-frame UV continuum and generally cannot be used to probe outflows from dusty or quenching galaxies. Na i d absorption is the only tracer that is routinely detected even in dusty and low SFR galaxies and is a good tracer of the mass in the dominant outflow phase. However, it is generally not detected in low mass galaxies, likely due to insufficient dust shielding. Bottom left: Emission-line outflows manifest as broad components (orange) super-imposed on narrower emission from the host galaxy (purple). Dotted and dashed curves show Gaussian profiles of individual emission lines, and solid curves show the summed profile of each component. Bottom right: Absorption-line outflows manifest as blueshifted components relative to the galaxy systemic velocity.

figures.caption_en: Figure 4: Schematic summarising the possible mechanisms driving the rapid quenching and ongoing quiescence of massive galaxies at cosmic noon. On the right, the solid green line and shaded region show the star-formation history of COSMOS-11142 ( Belli et al., 2024 ) , and the dashed line shows a possible extrapolation into the future for illustration purposes. Strong gas inflow/accretion likely triggered a burst of star-formation and AGN activity, driving a powerful outflow. This outflow ejected a large amount of cold gas, leading to rapid quenching and leaving the galaxy below the main sequence where it continues to drive a strong outflow ( Belli et al., 2024 ) . title: Mapping Dark Matter in Merging Clusters with Weak Lensing for CSST: Morphology and Filament Recovery
comment: 20 pages, 8 figures, 3 tables. Accepted for publication by APJ on 10/10/2026
summary: Weak gravitational lensing offers a direct probe of the projected dark matter distribution in cluster-scale structures and the surrounding cosmic web. We investigate the capability of the China Space Station Telescope (CSST) to recover non-spherical dark matter morphologies using mock reduced-shear maps generated from cosmological N-body simulations. We apply the deep-learning-based MIU2Net mass-reconstruction framework to CSST-like wide- and deep-field source densities, focusing on two representative systems: filament-connected halo pairs and elongated halos. MIU2Net accurately recovers halo centers, elongated mass distributions, and the filamentary structures connecting halo pairs in both survey configurations. Halo centers are localized within about 0.1 h^(-1) Mpc, and elongated-halo shapes and orientations are reliably recovered. Filament paths are stable against shape noise, with mean normalized instability parameters I_F, defined as the mean deviation from the true filament locus in units of R_200, decreasing from 0.041 to 0.037 in the low-redshift bin and from 0.051 to 0.045 in the high-redshift bin from the wide to deep field. The recovered filament shapes remain consistent with the true maps at the percent level. Compared with conventional Kaiser-Squires reconstruction, MIU2Net better preserves low-contrast anisotropic structures while suppressing small-scale noise. These results demonstrate that CSST weak-lensing data, combined with machine-learning-based mass reconstruction, will enable statistical studies of cluster assembly, anisotropic matter accretion, and the connection between massive halos and the filamentary cosmic web.

title: Narrowing down the Hubble constant value by exploiting the extended surface brightness of the supernova Refsdal host galaxy
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 1 table; submitted to A&A; replacement taking feedback of the community into account
summary: We present the first inference of the Hubble constant and matter density parameter from a strongly lensed supernova by exploiting the mass model of a galaxy cluster enhanced by an extended surface brightness reconstruction. Building upon the recent mass model of the galaxy cluster MACS J1149.5+2223, relying on the identified image positions only, we include the surface brightness distribution of the SN Refsdal host, to infer some cosmological parameter values within a flat LCDM framework. We consider two cosmological parameterizations, with either H0 and Ωm or H0 alone treated as free parameters, acknowledging the milder dependency on Ωm when incorporating additional constraints from the SN host. We explore four different mass-model realizations to assess some of the systematic uncertainties associated with the constraint weighting and source reconstruction. Although known as one of the main possible systematic effects, including influences from the external convergence, we deliberately keep the cluster total mass parametrization fixed to that of the previously published point-like mass model to enable a fair comparison. This reveals that incorporating 77,000 HST pixels reduces the uncertainty on the inferred value of the Hubble constant by a factor of 2.0, while all model realizations remain mutually consistent. Our final measurements are $H_0 = 65.0^{+2.0}_{-1.8}$ km/s/Mpc and $Ω_m = 0.30^{+0.08}_{-0.09}, in agreement with previous results. This corresponds to a substantially improved precision, reaching a remarkable 3.0% uncertainty on the value of H0 given our cluster total mass parameterization. The contributions of the uncertainties on the lens total mass and on the measured time delays to the final H0 error are now comparable, indicating that future improvements in cluster-scale time-delay cosmography will increasingly depend on (abridged version).

title: A JWST View of Cosmic Star Formation from $z\sim0$ to 9 with Hydrogen Recombination Lines in the COSMOS and GOODS-N fields
summary: We combine wide-area COSMOS-3D observations with deeper GOODS-N data from JWST/NIRCam F444W wide-field slitless spectroscopy to trace cosmic star formation over $z\sim0$--9. The observations cover approximately $0.33~\mathrm{deg}^2$ in COSMOS and $60.9~\mathrm{arcmin}^2$ in GOODS-N, with typical $3σ$ integrated line-flux limits of $3.2\times10^{-18}$ and $1.04\times10^{-18}~\mathrm{erg\,s^{-1}\,cm^{-2}}$, respectively. The common $3.9$--$5.0\,μ$m wavelength window probes Br$α$, Br$β$, Pa$α$, Pa$β$, H$α$, and H$β$ across the local Universe, cosmic noon, and reionization. Our final sample contains 9146 galaxies, including 7883 in COSMOS and 1263 in GOODS-N. COSMOS constrains luminous emitters, while GOODS-N extends the luminosity functions toward fainter sources. We measure dust-corrected line luminosities, account for line-detection completeness, and convert the six lines to equivalent H$α$ luminosities assuming Case B recombination. Schechter fits reveal an increase in the characteristic H$α$-equivalent luminosity toward cosmic noon. Integrating the resulting star formation rate functions above $0.24\,M_\odot\,\mathrm{yr}^{-1}$, we trace the cosmic star formation rate density from the local Universe to reionization. The combined Brackett, Paschen, and Balmer measurements are broadly consistent with the canonical UV- and IR-based cosmic star formation history at $z\lesssim6$. Fixed-slope tests show that the H$β$ estimate at $z\sim8$ remains sensitive to the external photometric faint-end constraint and extrapolation below our spectroscopic limit. These measurements provide complementary constraints on the distribution and integrated rate of star formation across cosmic time.

title: Mergers may not be the main channel for galaxy stellar mass growth at redshift $z\gtrsim5$: Predictions from cosmological hierarchical models and simulations
comment: Submitted to ApJ. Following a positive referee report, the manuscript is undergoing minor revisions
summary: Mergers are a crucial channel of galaxy growth, but their role relative to star formation remains uncertain at high redshift. Here we investigate merger rates and merger-driven stellar mass assembly for galaxies with stellar mass $M_\star \gtrsim 10^8 \, {\rm M_{\odot}}$ at $z\simeq 5-11$, by combining complementary theoretical approaches within $Λ$CDM. These include the DECODE semi-empirical model, the TNG100 and EAGLE hydrodynamical simulations, and the \textsc{L-Galaxies} semi-analytical model, together with the Millennium and TNG100-Dark simulations used to examine dark matter subhalo statistics and merger timescales. This compares models with different treatments of baryonic physics and galaxy-halo connections. We find that dark matter-only simulations predict merger timescales $\sim 30\%$ longer than those inferred from cosmological simulations including baryons. Galaxy major merger ($M_{\rm \star,sat} / M_{\rm \star,cen} > 0.25$) rates are high at cosmic dawn and increase towards earlier epochs, reaching $\sim 1/{\rm Gyr}$ at $z\sim 5$ and peaking at $\sim 3/{\rm Gyr}$ at $z\sim 8$. Despite these high rates, mergers contribute only $\lesssim 10\%$ of the total cosmic stellar mass density evolution. The ex-situ stellar mass fraction ranges from a few percent to $\sim 20\%$ for all galaxies at $z\gtrsim 5$, across different models and simulations. Their broad agreement implies that stellar mass assembly at cosmic dawn is dominated by in-situ star formation rather than mergers. These findings suggest that the high pair fractions identified by JWST may not directly trace efficient ex-situ stellar mass growth, highlighting the need for physically motivated merger timescales to interpret galaxy assembly in the early Universe.

artifacts.abstract_zh: 并合是星系增长的重要通道，但在高红移时其相对于恒星形成的作用仍不确定。本文结合 $\Lambda$CDM 框架内互补的理论方法，研究了在 $z\simeq 5-11$ 处恒星质量 $M_\star \gtrsim 10^8 \, {\rm M_{\odot}}$ 的星系的并合率以及并合驱动的恒星质量组装。这些方法包括 DECODE 半经验模型、TNG100 和 EAGLE 流体动力学模拟、\textsc{L-Galaxies} 半解析模型，以及用于检验暗物质子晕统计和并合时标的 Millennium 和 TNG100-Dark 模拟。这比较了具有不同重子物理处理和星系-晕连接方式的模型。我们发现，仅暗物质模拟预测的并合时标比包含重子的宇宙学模拟推断的时标长约 $\sim 30\%$。星系主并合（$M_{\rm \star,sat} / M_{\rm \star,cen} > 0.25$）率在宇宙黎明时期很高，并随着红移增加而上升，在 $z\sim 5$ 时达到 $\sim 1/{\rm Gyr}$，在 $z\sim 8$ 时达到峰值 $\sim 3/{\rm Gyr}$。尽管并合率很高，但并合对总宇宙恒星质量密度演化的贡献仅 $\lesssim 10\%$。在 $z\gtrsim 5$ 时，不同模型和模拟中所有星系的外源恒星质量分数从百分之几到 $\sim 20\%$ 不等。它们广泛一致表明，宇宙黎明时期的恒星质量组装由原位恒星形成主导，而非并合。这些发现表明，JWST 识别出的高双星系比例可能并不直接追踪有效的外源恒星质量增长，凸显了需要物理动机明确的并合时标来解释早期宇宙中的星系组装。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于可用摘要：宇宙黎明时期的恒星质量组装由原位恒星形成主导而非并合；JWST 观测到的高双星系比例可能并不直接对应有效的外源质量增长，需要物理动机明确的并合时标来解释早期宇宙星系组装。

title: Beneath the Surface: >85% of z>5.9 QSOs in Massive Host Galaxies are UV-Faint
comment: 13 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables, accepted in A&A, updated to match the version in press
summary: We use [CII] observations of a large quasi-stellar object (QSO) sample to segregate sources by host galaxy mass, aiming to identify those in the most massive hosts. [CII] luminosity, a known tracer of molecular gas, is taken as a proxy for host mass and used to rank 190 QSOs at z>5.9, spanning a 6-mag UV luminosity range (-22<Muv<-28). Particularly valuable are Atacama Large Millimeter Array (ALMA) data from a cycle-10 program, providing [CII] coverage for 46 UV-faint (M_{UV,AB}>-24.5) and 25 especially UV-faint (Muv>-23.5) QSOs, improving statistics by 5x and 6x, respectively. Taking massive host galaxies to be those where L[CII]>1.8x10^9 Lsol (median L[CII] of UV-bright QSOs), we identify 61 QSOs, including 13 which are UV-faint and 7 especially UV-faint. Using these selections and recent QSO luminosity functions (LFs), we present the first characterization of UV luminosity distribution for QSOs in massive host galaxies and quantify [CII] LFs for both UV-bright and UV-faint QSOs. While ~3% of massive-host QSOs are UV-bright (Muv<-26), >~85% are UV-faint (Muv>-24.5). This wide dispersion in UV luminosities reflects variations in dust obscuration, accretion efficiency, and black hole mass. Though spectroscopy is needed for definitive conclusions, black hole mass appears to be the dominant factor driving variations in the UV luminosity, based on 34 [CII]-luminous (L[CII]>1.8x10^9 Lsol) QSOs distributed across a ~3-mag baseline in UV luminosity and with measured MBH. At Muv~-23, the median extrapolated log10 (MBH/Msol) is 8.1+/-0.4, consistent with the local relation. Supermassive black holes (SMBHs) in UV-bright QSOs thus appear to be ~15(-9)(+25)x more massive than typical for massive host galaxies at z~6.

AI.tldr: 利用[CII]观测对大样本z>5.9 QSO按宿主星系质量分类，首次刻画大质量宿主QSO的紫外光度分布与[CII]光度函数，发现绝大多数大质量宿主QSO紫外偏暗，黑洞质量是紫外光度差异的主导因素。
AI.motivation: 识别处于最庞大宿主星系中的高红移QSO，并厘清大质量宿主QSO在紫外光度上的分布及其物理驱动因素（尘埃遮蔽、吸积效率、黑洞质量）。
AI.method: 以[CII]光度（分子气体示踪、作为宿主质量代理）对190个z>5.9、跨越6星等紫外光度范围（-22<Muv<-28）的QSO排序；结合ALMA cycle-10数据为46个紫外暗弱及25个极暗弱QSO提供[CII]覆盖（统计量分别提升5倍和6倍）；以L[CII]>1.8×10^9 Lsol（紫外明亮QSO的中位值）定义大质量宿主，并借助近期QSO光度函数进行分析。
AI.result: 共识别61个大质量宿主QSO，其中13个紫外暗弱、7个极暗弱；大质量宿主QSO中约3%为紫外明亮（Muv<-26），而≥85%为紫外暗弱（Muv>-24.5）。34个[CII]明亮且测得MBH的QSO跨越约3星等紫外基线；在Muv~-23处外推的中位log10(MBH/Msol)=8.1±0.4，与本地关系一致；紫外明亮QSO中的超大质量黑洞比z~6大质量宿主星系的典型值重约15(-9)(+25)倍。
AI.conclusion: 大质量宿主QSO的紫外光度分布极宽，反映尘埃遮蔽、吸积效率与黑洞质量的差异，其中黑洞质量似为主导因素；紫外明亮QSO的超大质量黑洞显著重于同红移大质量宿主星系的典型水平，但确定结论仍需光谱观测。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 我们利用对一个大类星体（QSO）样本的[CII]观测，按宿主星系质量对源进行分类，旨在识别那些位于最大质量宿主星系中的源。[CII]光度是已知的分子气体示踪物，被用作宿主质量的代理，并用于对190个z>5.9的QSO进行排序，这些QSO跨越6个星等的紫外光度范围（-22<Muv<-28）。特别有价值的是来自阿塔卡马大型毫米波阵列（ALMA）第10周期项目的数据，为46个紫外暗弱（M_{UV,AB}>-24.5）和25个特别紫外暗弱（Muv>-23.5）的QSO提供了[CII]覆盖，分别将统计量提高了5倍和6倍。将大质量宿主星系定义为L[CII]>1.8x10^9 Lsol（紫外明亮QSO的[CII]中值）的星系，我们识别出61个QSO，其中包括13个紫外暗弱和7个特别紫外暗弱的QSO。利用这些选择以及最近的QSO光度函数（LFs），我们首次表征了大质量宿主星系中QSO的紫外光度分布，并量化了紫外明亮和紫外暗弱QSO的[CII] LFs。虽然约3%的大质量宿主QSO是紫外明亮的（Muv<-26），但>~85%是紫外暗弱的（Muv>-24.5）。紫外光度的这种广泛离散反映了尘埃遮蔽、吸积效率和黑洞质量的变化。尽管需要光谱学才能得出确定性结论，但基于34个[CII]明亮（L[CII]>1.8x10^9 Lsol）QSO（它们分布在约3个星等的紫外光度基线上并具有测量的MBH），黑洞质量似乎是驱动紫外光度变化的主要因素。在Muv~-23处，外推的log10 (MBH/Msol)中值为8.1+/-0.4，与本地关系一致。因此，紫外明亮QSO中的超大质量黑洞（SMBHs）似乎比z~6时大质量宿主星系的典型值重约15(-9)(+25)倍。

title: Emergence of high-mass stars in complex fiber networks (EMERGE) VII. Multi-Tracer Column Density Synthesis
comment: 16 pages, 16 figures. Accepted for publication by A&A
summary: Obtaining accurate estimates of the gas column density $\mathrm{N(H_2)}$ is crucial to determine the physical conditions of the molecular gas in the Interstellar Medium. This paper introduces the "Multi-Tracer Column Density Synthesis" (MT-CDS) technique, a new empirical approach to derive high dynamic-range column density maps with interferometers such as ALMA. We have compared the integrated intensity maps of two density selective tracers, namely HNC (1-0) and $\mathrm{N_2H^+}$ (1-0), obtained with IRAM-30m with ancillary Herschel column density estimates in seven star-forming regions in Orion and derived individual temperature-corrected conversion factors for each of these tracers. We applied these conversion factors obtained at low-resolution into similar high sensitivity ALMA observations to derive independent column density maps describing both the low $N_\mathrm{HNC}\mathrm{(H_2)}$ and high $N_\mathrm{N_2H^+}\mathrm{(H_2)}$ column density components at high spatial resolution (4.5"). We also combined these independent maps into estimates for the total gas column density gas $N_\mathrm{tot}\mathrm{(H_2)}$ sampling more than two orders of magnitude in column density between $\sim 10^{21.5}-10^{23.5}$ cm$^{-2}$. A comparison with independent ArTeMiS column density maps at intermediate resolution (8") shows typical deviations of $\lesssim$0.2 dex from our MT-CDS gas column density estimates. We obtained individual column density maps in five of our targets at $\sim$2000 au resolution in which ALMA observations were available, that is a factor of $\sim$5 better than originally calibrated. These results demonstrate the potential of this MT-CDS technique to retrieve accurate, high dynamic range $N\mathrm{(H_2)}$ total gas column density estimates at interferometric resolution combining multiple molecular line tracers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"多示踪剂柱密度合成"(MT-CDS)新技术，利用ALMA等干涉仪结合HNC(1-0)与N₂H⁺(1-0)两种密度选择性示踪剂，以经验方法获得高动态范围的分子气体柱密度图。
AI.motivation: 准确测量气体柱密度N(H₂)对于确定星际介质分子气体的物理条件至关重要。传统方法在干涉仪高分辨率下难以同时实现高动态范围与准确度，尤其是同时覆盖低密度与高密度气体成分。因此需要一种新的经验性方法，在干涉仪分辨率下获得高动态范围的总气体柱密度图。
AI.method: 在Orion的七个恒星形成区，将IRAM-30m获得的HNC(1-0)和N₂H⁺(1-0)积分强度图与Herschel柱密度估计进行比较，为每种示踪剂导出温度校正的转换因子。随后将低分辨率得到的转换因子应用于类似的高灵敏度ALMA观测，分别导出低N_HNC(H₂)和高N_N₂H⁺(H₂)柱密度成分的高空间分辨率(4.5″)独立柱密度图，并合并为总气体柱密度N_tot(H₂)估计。
AI.result: 该方法覆盖柱密度范围从约10^21.5至10^23.5 cm⁻²，超过两个数量级。与中等分辨率(8″)的独立ArTeMiS柱密度图比较，典型偏差≲0.2 dex。在有ALMA观测的五个目标中，获得了约2000 au分辨率的柱密度图，比原始校准提高了约5倍。
AI.conclusion: MT-CDS技术展示了结合多种分子谱线示踪剂在干涉仪分辨率下获得准确、高动态范围总气体柱密度估计的潜力。

title: Wave Cold Dark Matter Can Reproduce the Radial Acceleration Relation in X-ray Elliptical Galaxies
comment: Accepted. Comments welcome. 1. No quantum pressure for $ρ\propto r^{-2}$ (see Eq. 13). 2. "Basic Notions are more important than Numerical Simulations."
summary: Wave cold dark matter (wave CDM) is a well-motivated variant within the collisionless CDM paradigm, in which the de~Broglie wavelengths of ultralight bosons become relevant on galactic scales. While many of the previous tests of wave CDM have focused on small-scale tensions involving solitonic cores and certain soliton--halo relations in galaxies, the radial acceleration relation (RAR) provides a complementary test: for a given baryonic mass distribution, it probes whether the DM halo can reproduce the observed total gravitational field. In this work we test wave CDM against the RAR using eight X-ray elliptical galaxies from the compilation of Lelli et al. We perform a suite of 3D Schrödinger--Poisson simulations and evolve the wave-CDM halos to virialized quasi-stationary states. For each galaxy and each adopted boson mass, we select the realization whose final snapshot most closely matches the empirical RAR. We find that the selected wave-CDM realizations for these elliptical galaxies can reproduce the RAR without including baryonic feedback or dark-matter self-interactions. At the boson mass $m_a=10^{-23}$eV, the combined fit to the eight galaxies gives $a_0=1.19\times10^{-10}\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-2}}$, consistent with the canonical value inferred from disk galaxies. When the boson mass is varied over $3\times 10^{-24}$ eV $\le m_a \le 2\times 10^{-23}$ eV, the best-fit value of $a_0$ changes by only $\sim 11\%$, and this variation shows no systematic trend with $m_a$. This insensitivity to boson mass arises because, over the radial range relevant for the RAR, the virialized halos are supported mainly by their velocity field, whereas the boson-mass-dependent quantum-pressure term is dynamically subdominant. These results show that wave CDM can reproduce the RAR in elliptical galaxies, and provide a new galactic-scale test of the model beyond the previous focus on solitonic cores.

artifacts.abstract_zh: 波暗物质（wave CDM）是无碰撞冷暗物质（CDM）范式下一种动机充分的变体，其中超轻玻色子的德布罗意波长在星系尺度上变得重要。虽然此前对波暗物质的许多检验都集中在涉及孤子核和星系中某些孤子—晕关系的小尺度张力上，但径向加速度关系（RAR）提供了一种互补的检验：对于给定的重子质量分布，它探测暗物质晕能否重现观测到的总引力场。在本工作中，我们利用 Lelli 等人汇编中的八个 X 射线椭圆星系，对波暗物质进行 RAR 检验。我们进行了一系列三维薛定谔—泊松模拟，并将波暗物质晕演化到维里化准稳态。对于每个星系和每个采用的玻色子质量，我们选择其最终快照最接近经验 RAR 的实现。我们发现，这些椭圆星系所选的波暗物质实现可以在不包含重子反馈或暗物质自相互作用的情况下重现 RAR。在玻色子质量 $m_a=10^{-23}$eV 时，对八个星系的联合拟合给出 $a_0=1.19\times10^{-10}\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-2}}$，与从盘星系推断的典型值一致。当玻色子质量在 $3\times 10^{-24}$ eV $\le m_a \le 2\times 10^{-23}$ eV 范围内变化时，$a_0$ 的最佳拟合值仅变化 $\sim 11\%$，并且这种变化与 $m_a$ 没有系统趋势。这种对玻色子质量的不敏感性源于：在 RAR 相关的径向范围内，维里化晕主要由其速度场支撑，而依赖玻色子质量的量子压力项在动力学上处于次要地位。这些结果表明，波暗物质可以在椭圆星系中重现 RAR，并为该模型提供了超越此前对孤子核关注的新星系尺度检验。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 我们展示了来自文献 [13] 汇编的八个 X 射线椭圆星系的波暗物质晕的三维薛定谔—泊松模拟。我们检验了维里化波暗物质晕能否重现观测到的径向加速度关系（RAR），并得到两个主要发现。• 波暗物质可以在椭圆星系中重现 RAR。对于基准玻色子质量 \(m_{22}\equiv m_{a}/10^{-22}{eV}=0.1\)，对来自所有八个星系所选最佳匹配数值实现的 \(6724\) 个径向数据点的联合拟合给出 \(a_{0}=1.19\times 10^{-10}\,{m\,s^{-2}}\)，接近晚型盘星系报道的典型值 \(1.20\times 10^{-10}\,{m\,s^{-2}}\) [13]。单个星系拟合得到的 \(a_{0}\) 值范围为 \((1.02\) – \(1.39)\times 10^{-10}\,{m\,s^{-2}}\)（表 1），与典型值的偏差至多 \(\sim 16\,\%\)——小于来自恒星光度质量比 \(\Upsilon\) 的 \(\sim 20\,\%\) 系统不确定性 [13]。这些实现的每个弛豫系统都表现出 \(g_{{b}}\) 与 \(g_{{total}}\) 之间的紧密关联，其残差散布与晚型星系报道的相似。因此，这些无碰撞波暗物质的维里化晕可以在不引入外流反馈（来自超新星或活动星系核）、有限温度效应、暗物质自相互作用或暗物质与重子之间任何耦合机制的情况下重现 RAR。• RAR 对玻色子质量 \(m_{a}\) 不敏感，且特征加速度 \(a_{0}\) 与 \(m_{a}\) 不相关。在 \(0.03\leq m_{22}\leq 0.2\) 范围内，对所有八个星系进行了模拟，我们发现所有情况下重子加速度与总引力加速度之间都存在紧密关联。最佳拟合特征加速度（\(a_{0}\)）仅从 \((1.06\) – \(1.19)\times 10^{-10}\,{m\,s^{-2}}\) 变化（表 4），与典型值 \(1.20\times 10^{-10}\,{m\,s^{-2}}\) 的偏差为 \(\sim 11\,\%\)。对于 NGC 720，我们的更高分辨率模拟将探索的玻色子质量扩展到 \(m_{22}=0.4\)，所得的 \(a_{0}\) 值仍处于同一范围内。此外，从图 2 和图 3 可以明显看出，\(a_{0}\) 的变化与 \(m_{a}\) 没有系统趋势。正如第 4.3 节所分析，这种不敏感性的物理起源简单而透明。在 Madelung 表述中，玻色子质量仅通过量子压力项进入量子欧拉方程。然而，在 RAR 相关的半径处，量子压力力被强烈抑制：它随半径迅速减小，并且当晕密度剖面接近 \(r^{-2}\) 形式时进一步降低。因此，改变 \(m_{a}\) 对 RAR 所探测径向范围内的力平衡几乎没有影响。在已进入由弱波湍流维持的非平衡准稳态（NEQSS）的弛豫波暗物质晕中，RAR 相关半径处的引力场在动力学上主要由晕速度场平衡，包括速度色散压力和可能的整体运动如旋转，而不是由依赖玻色子质量的量子压力平衡。这一点似乎与所有基于旋转曲线的波暗物质分析相关：除非观测直接探测量子压力主导的区域，否则仅靠旋转曲线预计无法对玻色子质量提供稳健约束。我们将在后续工作中更详细地研究这一问题。事实上，这种对粒子质量的不敏感性是 CDM 范式的一般本质（参见 [41] 以获取更多讨论以及关于 JWST 近期谜题的含义）。大多数观测量是在宏观尺度上测量的，此时系统已对动力学尺度及相应的非线性动力学过程进行了有效粗粒化（更不用说微观尺度和动力学过程）。因此，暗物质粒子的详细微观物理身份在很大程度上被隐藏了。无论暗部门由粒子还是超轻场、费米子还是玻色子组成，只要量子或其他微观物理效应在动力学上处于次要地位，其现象学就可以保持为无碰撞 CDM 的一般特征。微观物理与宏观行为之间的这种分离是 CDM 范式长期现象学成功的原因之一。

title: The Dance of the Little Red Dots: Spectroscopy of Two Blue Companions at z = 3.9 and 5.5 Reveals Young, Metal-Poor Starbursts Merging with Their LRDs within a Few Hundred Myr
comment: Submitted for publication in The Astrophysical Journal Letters. 14 pages, 4 figures
summary: The Little Red Dots (LRDs) are compact, red sources, abundant at $4 \lesssim z \lesssim 9$ and likely powered by massive black holes. Photometric studies have found blue companions around them, but none has yet been confirmed spectroscopically. This Letter presents the only two LRD-companion pairs with spectroscopy of both members in the literature: "Waltz" at $z = 3.9$ and "Tango" at $z = 5.5$, with projected separations of $3.6$ and $2.5$ kpc. Both companions lie at the redshift of their LRD, within $132 \, \rm km \, s^{-1}$ and $57 \, \rm km \, s^{-1}$, and are physically identical, but $524$ Myr apart: starbursts $\lesssim 50$ Myr old, metal-poor ($0.2 \, \rm Z_\odot$), dust-free, dynamically cold, and as bright as the LRDs themselves in the rest-frame UV. The LRD in Waltz hosts a $\approx 3 \times 10^{6} \, \rm M_\odot$ black hole accreting at half the Eddington rate, a factor of a few above the birth mass of a direct collapse black hole, and is embedded in gas as metal-poor as its companion. Orbital modeling shows that Tango is bound in $81\%$ of the allowed orbits and that Waltz is bound if its host halo exceeds $5 \times 10^{10} \, \rm M_\odot$. Both blue companions then merge with their respective LRD within a few hundred Myr. We conclude that we are observing what heavy seeding requires: a young black hole beside the metal-poor starburst that the synchronized-pair scenario predicts, in the last steps of a cosmic dance that ends in a merger, and in a galaxy seeded by its black hole.

title: Non-equilibrium chemistry and radiation hydrodynamics in metal-poor and metal-rich interstellar gas
comment: 23 pages, 12 figures (+ appendix). Submitted to AAS Journals; comments welcome
summary: We present a flexible implementation of non-equilibrium chemical networks with the $\texttt{KROME}$ framework, coupled to a nonlocal variable Eddington tensor-closed radiation transport scheme ($\texttt{VETTAM}$). Our fiducial network is designed to explicitly capture the formation pathways of important molecular species such as CO, OH, and $\rm H_2O$, intermediaries like $\rm H_3^+$, and the destruction of these species through photon and cosmic-ray dissociation. We validate our scheme through benchmark tests, and demonstrate its success in 1D and 3D problems covering a broad range of metallicities ($0 \leq Z \lesssim \rm Z_{\odot}$) and densities ($n \lesssim 10^{17} \, \rm cm^{-3}$). We confirm earlier works that suggest that OH and $\rm H_2O$ are the key molecular species in dense gas ($n \gtrsim 10^{5} \, \rm cm^{-3}$) for $Z\lesssim 0.01 \rm Z_{\odot}$, dominate the cooling at these densities, and demonstrate that our scheme can reproduce their abundances with similar accuracy as dedicated static photo-dissociation region (PDR) codes. We also find that the dominant fine-structure coolant in dense ($n \gtrsim 10^3 \, \, \rm cm^{-3}$) PDRs transitions from CI to CII to OI at increasingly lower $Z$. Finally, we find that in turbulent media, rapid mixing at PDR interfaces renders the chemical species out of equilibrium, and show that this could potentially alleviate the long-standing problem of (static) PDR models producing excess CI in the diffuse ISM over UV absorption-line measurements. We conclude by presenting and comparing with alternative implementations of reduced but faster chemical networks in our scheme, discussing the problem-dependent performance-accuracy tradeoffs and future prospects.

AI.tldr: 该工作将非平衡化学网络框架KROME与非局域变爱丁顿张量辐射输运方法VETTAM耦合，构建了一个灵活的非平衡化学-辐射联合求解方案，并在1D/3D多金属丰度、多密度环境下验证了其对CO、OH、H2O等分子及冷却过程的模拟能力。
AI.motivation: 现有光致离解区（PDR）研究多依赖静态模型，难以刻画湍流介质中化学与辐射的非平衡耦合；同时静态PDR模型长期存在弥散ISM中CI过量的问题。作者希望建立一个能灵活处理非平衡化学网络、覆盖广泛金属丰度与密度范围、并可耦合辐射输运的数值框架。
AI.method: 采用KROME框架实现灵活的非平衡化学网络，并与非局域变爱丁顿张量闭合辐射输运方案VETTAM耦合。基准网络显式刻画CO、OH、H2O的生成路径、H3+等中间体，以及光子和宇宙线离解导致的破坏。通过基准测试验证方案，并在1D和3D问题中测试金属丰度0≤Z≲Z⊙、密度n≲1e17 cm^-3范围的表现。此外还实现并与较简化但更快的化学网络进行对比。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个灵活的非平衡化学网络实现，采用$\texttt{KROME}$框架，并与非局部可变爱丁顿张量闭合辐射输运方案（$\texttt{VETTAM}$）耦合。我们的基准网络旨在明确捕捉重要分子物种如CO、OH和$\rm H_2O$的形成路径，中间体如$\rm H_3^+$，以及这些物种通过光子和宇宙射线解离的破坏。我们通过基准测试验证了我们的方案，并展示了其在涵盖广泛金属丰度（$0 \leq Z \lesssim \rm Z_{\odot}$）和密度（$n \lesssim 10^{17} \, \rm cm^{-3}$）的1D和3D问题中的成功。我们证实了先前的工作，表明在致密气体（$n \gtrsim 10^{5} \, \rm cm^{-3}$）中，对于$Z\lesssim 0.01 \rm Z_{\odot}$，OH和$\rm H_2O$是关键分子物种，在这些密度下主导冷却，并证明我们的方案能够以与专用静态光解离区（PDR）代码相似的精度再现它们的丰度。我们还发现，在致密（$n \gtrsim 10^3 \, \, \rm cm^{-3}$）PDR中，主导的精细结构冷却剂随着$Z$的降低从CI转变为CII再转变为OI。最后，我们发现在湍流介质中，PDR界面的快速混合使化学物种脱离平衡，并表明这可能潜在地缓解长期存在的（静态）PDR模型在漫射ISM中产生过量CI而超过紫外吸收线测量的问题。我们最后展示并比较了在我们的方案中简化但更快的化学网络的替代实现，讨论了依赖于问题的性能-精度权衡和未来前景。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 该耦合方案可成功处理广泛的金属丰度与密度条件，并具备与专用PDR代码相当的精度。湍流界面混合导致的非平衡效应揭示了静态PDR模型的局限，为解释CI过量问题提供了新思路。文中还讨论了简化化学网络的性能-精度权衡与未来方向。

title: CausticFlow: An Efficient Machine Learning Framework Combining Neural Differential Equations and Normalizing Flows for Binary Microlensing Parameter Inference
summary: We introduce CausticFlow, a machine learning framework that combines neural controlled differential equations with normalizing flows to infer binary microlensing parameters. This architecture naturally handles irregularly sampled time series and data gaps while flexibly capturing strongly correlated and multimodal posterior distributions. Trained on simulated KMTNet-like light curves, CausticFlow generates posterior samples in a fraction of a second, with maximum-a-posteriori estimates achieving typical precisions of $\sim17\%$ for the mass ratio $q$ and $\sim3\%$ for the projected separation $s$. When used as a proposal distribution for downstream local optimization, the framework improves these precisions to $<5\%$ and $<1\%$, respectively, and recovers model $χ^2$ for $\sim80\%$ of simulated events. We test the generalizability of the framework on 10 real binary lensing events characterized by higher-order effects, varied cadences, and real-world noise. Despite these mismatches between simulation and reality, CausticFlow successfully recovers the model parameters, light-curve morphology, and lensing geometry for 7 of the 10 events after simple local refinement, achieving precision levels comparable to those found for simulated data in 10 CPU minutes per event. These results demonstrate that CausticFlow acts as a fast and robust proposal engine that provides informative starting points for downstream local optimization, bridging the gap between the rapid influx of data and the need for systematic modeling in large-scale microlensing surveys such as Roman, CSST, and ET.

figures.caption_en: Figure 1: Overview of the CausticFlow architecture. Given an irregularly sampled light curve \(\mathcal{D}=\{(t_{i},x_{i})\}\) , the framework first applies a log-signature transformation to construct a compact control path \(X\) . An initial network maps the initial value of the control path to the initial hidden state of the Neural CDE. The Neural CDE then evolves this hidden state along the full control path and produces the final summary state \(z_{t_{N}}\) . A readout network maps \(z_{t_{N}}\) to the conditioning vector \(c_{\phi}(\mathcal{D})\) , which is passed to a conditional normalizing flow. The flow transforms a simple base distribution into a surrogate posterior \(p(\theta\mid c_{\phi}(\mathcal{D}))\) over the predicted binary lens parameters defined in Section III.1 .
figures.caption_zh: 图1：CausticFlow架构概述。给定不规则采样的光变曲线\(\mathcal{D}=\{(t_{i},x_{i})\}\)，框架首先应用对数签名变换构建紧凑的控制路径\(X\)。初始网络将控制路径的初始值映射到神经CDE的初始隐藏状态。然后，神经CDE沿整个控制路径演化该隐藏状态，并产生最终摘要状态\(z_{t_{N}}\)。读出网络将\(z_{t_{N}}\)映射到条件向量\(c_{\phi}(\mathcal{D})\)，该向量被传递给条件归一化流。流将简单的基础分布转换为预测的双星透镜参数（定义见第III.1节）上的代理后验\(p(\theta\mid c_{\phi}(\mathcal{D}))\)。

title: Twisted Pseudodisk and Asymmetric Mass Accretion on the Circumstellar Disk II: Parameter Survey
summary: Using three-dimensional magnetohydrodynamic simulations accounting for ohmic dissipation, we investigate the long-term evolution of the infalling envelope for $\sim 100,000$\,yr after protostar formation. The primary control parameter is the initial misalignment angle $θ_0$ between the rotation axis and the magnetic field, varied from $0^\circ$ to $90^\circ$. In all misaligned models ($θ_0 \ne 0^\circ$), the pseudodisk (or infalling envelope) surrounding the circumstellar disk develops a highly distorted and complex morphology. Gas accretion from the envelope proceeds through discrete, channel-like flows, producing asymmetric streams rather than axisymmetric infall. Protostellar outflows are launched even in these complex environments, and inflow and outflow regions are strongly interwoven. Outflows transport angular momentum anisotropically, leading to time-dependent changes in disk orientation and outflow direction, which further enhance envelope asymmetry. We examine the relative orientation between gas flows and magnetic fields and find that, although statistical tendencies exist, accretion streams cannot be uniquely characterized as either parallel or perpendicular to the magnetic field, particularly in strongly misaligned cases. We also show that most infalling gas accretes at nearly the free-fall velocity, with only a minor fraction significantly slowed within the pseudodisk. Asymmetric accretion and stream-like structures persist beyond 10,000\,au, demonstrating that large-scale asymmetry can arise intrinsically. Our results show that complex streams and asymmetric envelopes naturally emerge from magnetized core physics, even in the absence of initial turbulence or external gas accretion.

title: Tracing Accretion and Inner-Disk Gas Evolution in the Orion Nebula via Br-alpha and CO
summary: We present a systematic spectroscopic study of hydrogen Brackett-alpha (Br-alpha) and carbon monoxide (CO) fundamental-band (4.3-5.2 micron) emission from a homogeneous sample of 0.2-1.5 Msun pre-main-sequence (PMS) stars in the Orion Nebula observed with JWST/NIRSpec-MOS as part of our Chandra-JWST project. Using 73 Br-alpha and 46 CO spectra, we investigate correlations between warm-gas emission, stellar properties, accretion, and environment with censored correlation and regression analyses accounting for multiple testing. Br-alpha luminosity correlates strongly with accretion luminosity (Lacc), even after excluding sources within 2' of Theta1 Ori C, the nebula's main ionizing O-type star, whose radiation may bias proplyd Lacc estimates. This supports Br-alpha as a robust empirical tracer of accretion in PMS stars. Br-alpha also correlates with visual extinction (Av) and more weakly with stellar bolometric luminosity and mass. CO fundamental-band luminosities likewise correlate positively with Lacc and Av, relationships that persist in a larger combined JWST/NIRSpec+MIRI sample spanning multiple star-forming regions. In contrast to Br-alpha, CO luminosity shows no significant dependence on basic stellar properties, suggesting that warm molecular gas is governed primarily by accretion and local disk conditions. The weaker correlations of the Spitzer/IRAC spectral slope with Lacc and Av suggest that warm inner-disk gas may evolve or disperse faster than optically thick dust. Overall, the CO results tentatively indicate declining warm-gas emission as disks evolve, modulated by accretion-powered thermal and ultraviolet excitation, although variations in emitting area inherited from natal core conditions may also contribute.

artifacts.abstract_zh: 我们利用JWST/NIRSpec-MOS对猎户座星云中0.2-1.5 Msun前主序星均匀样本的氢Brackett-alpha（Br-alpha）和一氧化碳（CO）基频带（4.3-5.2微米）发射进行了系统性光谱研究，这是Chandra-JWST项目的一部分。使用73条Br-alpha和46条CO光谱，我们通过截尾相关和回归分析（考虑多重检验）研究了暖气体发射、恒星性质、吸积和环境之间的相关性。Br-alpha光度与吸积光度（Lacc）强烈相关，即使在排除位于星云主要电离O型星Theta1 Ori C 2'范围内的源后也是如此，这些源的辐射可能使proplyd的Lacc估计产生偏差。这支持Br-alpha作为前主序星吸积的稳健经验示踪物。Br-alpha还与视觉消光（Av）相关，与恒星热辐射光度和质量的相关性较弱。CO基频带光度同样与Lacc和Av呈正相关，这些关系在跨越多个恒星形成区的更大的JWST/NIRSpec+MIRI联合样本中持续存在。与Br-alpha相反，CO光度对基本恒星性质没有显著依赖，表明暖分子气体主要受吸积和局部盘条件支配。Spitzer/IRAC光谱斜率与Lacc和Av的相关性较弱，表明暖内盘气体可能比光学厚尘埃演化或消散得更快。总体而言，CO结果初步表明暖气体发射随盘演化而减弱，受吸积驱动的热和紫外激发调控，尽管出生核条件导致的发射面积差异也可能有贡献。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于可用摘要：Br-alpha是前主序星吸积的稳健经验示踪物；暖分子气体主要受吸积和局部盘条件支配，而非恒星基本性质；暖内盘气体可能比光学厚尘埃演化或消散得更快；CO结果初步表明暖气体发射随盘演化而减弱，受吸积驱动的热与紫外激发调控，但出生核条件导致的发射面积差异也可能有贡献。

title: Massive double-exponential galaxies with extended LSB emission: An IllustrisTNG exploration II -are they unique?
comment: 19 pages, 8 figures ( 2 figures in Appendix), 1 Table, Submitted to ApJ
summary: The massive disk galaxies (stellar mass >= 10^11 M_solar ) in the local universe (z < 0.1) encode challenging aspects of galaxy formation physics. We have studied one class of such galaxies - the giant low surface brightness galaxies (gLSBs) that show a hybrid morphology - a central Sersic, an inner high surface brightness, exponential stellar disk surrounded by an outer, extended low surface brightness disk, using large volume IllustrisTNG-100 simulation. This is motivated by the recent observation of several such systems and an earlier work by Sarkar & Saha (2025) from IllustrisTNG-50. We find that despite using a ~ 10 times larger volume simulation, only ~11% of massive disk galaxies show such morphology, consistent with findings from TNG50. This shows robustly that such galaxies are not common in the local universe. We compared them with the typical disk galaxies from observations, and single-exponential gLSBs from TNG100. We show that while the inner disk components lie well within the central surface brightness vs. radial scale length distribution of the typical disks, the outer LSB disks lie significantly at the outskirt, occupying a unique space. Their median bulge-to-total ratio is ~ 0.2 making them disk dominated, similar to the typical disks and the single-exponential gLSBs. We find their median dark matter mass fraction to be high (~ 0.9), typical of gLSBs. The outer LSB disks reach fainter central surface brightness and larger scale length values than the single-exponential gLSBs. Our exploration will be useful in understanding their formation mechanism across cosmic time.

AI.tldr: 利用TNG100大体积模拟研究巨型低表面亮度星系（gLSBs）的混合形态特征，发现仅约11%的大质量盘星系呈现此类形态，且其外盘占据独特的参数空间。
AI.motivation: 本地宇宙大质量盘星系的形成机制是星系形成物理中的难题。近期观测到若干具混合形态（中心Sersic核+内层高表面亮度盘+外层延展低表面亮度盘）的巨型低表面亮度星系（gLSBs），Sarkar & Saha (2025) 基于TNG50已开展初步研究，本文希望借助更大体积的模拟验证其普遍性并深入刻画其特征。
AI.method: 使用大体积IllustrisTNG-100模拟，识别具有混合形态的gLSBs，并将其与观测中的典型盘星系以及TNG100中的单指数gLSBs进行对比分析，考察其表面亮度、标长、核球占比及暗物质质量分数等参数。
AI.result: 即便模拟体积扩大约10倍，仍仅有约11%的大质量盘星系呈现该混合形态，与TNG50结果一致。内盘落在典型盘星系的中心表面亮度—标长分布内，而外低表面亮度盘显著位于分布边缘，占据独特参数空间。中位核球-总质量比约0.2（盘主导），与典型盘及单指数gLSBs相近；中位暗物质质量分数较高（约0.9），符合gLSBs特征；外LSB盘比单指数gLSBs具有更暗的中心表面亮度和更大的标长。
AI.conclusion: 该混合形态在大质量盘星系中并不普遍，结果在更大体积模拟中得到稳健验证。研究刻画了gLSBs外盘的独特性质，有助于理解其跨宇宙时间的形成机制。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 本地宇宙（z < 0.1）中的大质量盘星系（恒星质量 >= 10^11 M_solar）编码了星系形成物理中具有挑战性的方面。我们利用大体积 IllustrisTNG-100 模拟研究了一类这样的星系——巨型低表面亮度星系（gLSBs），它们表现出混合形态：中心 Sersic、内部高表面亮度、指数恒星盘，被外部延展的低表面亮度盘包围。这受到最近对几个此类系统的观测以及 Sarkar & Saha (2025) 基于 IllustrisTNG-50 的早期工作的启发。我们发现，尽管使用了约 10 倍更大体积的模拟，只有约 11% 的大质量盘星系表现出这种形态，与 TNG50 的发现一致。这有力地表明，这类星系在本地宇宙中并不常见。我们将它们与观测中的典型盘星系以及 TNG100 中的单指数 gLSBs 进行了比较。我们表明，虽然内部盘组件很好地落在典型盘的中心表面亮度与径向尺度长度分布内，但外部 LSB 盘显著地位于外围，占据独特的空间。它们的中位核球与总光度比约为 0.2，使其成为盘主导，类似于典型盘和单指数 gLSBs。我们发现它们的中位暗物质质量分数很高（约 0.9），是 gLSBs 的典型特征。外部 LSB 盘达到比单指数 gLSBs 更暗的中心表面亮度和更大的尺度长度值。我们的探索将有助于理解它们跨宇宙时间的形成机制。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于可用摘要：该混合形态在大质量盘星系中并不普遍，结果在更大体积模拟中得到稳健验证。研究刻画了gLSBs外盘的独特性质，有助于理解其跨宇宙时间的形成机制。

title: Constraints on the cosmic reheating history from PTA data
summary: The cosmic reheating is an important epoch in the very early Universe, and has significant impacts on the primordial black hole (PBH) abundance and the scalar-induced gravitational wave (SIGW) spectrum. The relevant energy scale and the constituents of cosmic medium are encoded in the reheating frequency $f_{\mathrm{reh}}$ and the equation of state parameter $w$. In this work, we perform a full parameter space Bayesian inference, using the NANOGrav 15-yr dataset to constrain the thermal history of reheating. Treating $f_{\mathrm{reh}}$ and $w$ as free parameters, we systematically investigate the Dirac $δ$, narrow and broad log-normal primordial power spectra. Current pulsar timing array data can effectively constrain the peak frequency of the SIGW spectrum as $f_{\rm p}\sim 10^{-7.6}$--$10^{-7.0}$ Hz, along with $f_{\rm reh}\sim 10^{-9.0}$--$10^{-8.3}$ Hz and $w\sim 0.19$--$0.79$ (the $68\%$ confidence level), when the power spectrum has a relatively narrow width $Δ\lesssim 1$. A broader power spectrum introduces a smoothing effect that obscures the characteristic frequency knee in the SIGW spectrum, leading to the loss of information about cosmic reheating. Furthermore, for the Dirac $δ$ and narrow spectra, the PBH masses associated with the SIGWs are anchored at the planetary mass scale around $10^{-6}$--$10^{-4} M_{\odot}$. This establishes a consistent physical framework that naturally bridges the nanohertz gravitational wave background with the dark matter candidates implied by the Optical Gravitational Lensing Experiment microlensing events.

title: OGLE-2016-BLG-0523: A Low-mass Brown Dwarf or super-Jupiter in a $>100$ au Orbit
summary: To search for very wide-orbit binary-lens events, we cross-match microlensing events detected by OGLE-IV and KMTNet between 2011 and 2024. After removing contaminants from variable stars, we identify OGLE-2016-BLG-0523 as a microlensing event showing two short-lived bumps in its light curve, with the two separated by 8.36 yr. We investigate three scenarios to explain the two bumps, including a binary-lens single-source (2L1S), a single-lens binary-source (1L2S), and two unrelated single-lens single-source events (2$\times$1L1S). The 1L2S interpretation is excluded due to its poorer fit to the data, while the 2$\times$1L1S scenario is disfavored by the low event rate, unphysical total source flux, and unphysical color for one of the two putative sources. For the surviving 2L1S interpretation, the Einstein timescales of the two bumps are $8.343 \pm 0.076$ days and $3.231 \pm 0.047$ days, respectively, implying a binary mass ratio of $q = 0.15$. A Bayesian analysis indicates that the primary lens is most likely a low-mass M dwarf, while the companion is probably a low-mass brown dwarf or super-Jupiter. The inferred projected separation is about 450 au, making the companion the widest low-mass object discovered via microlensing to date. Our discovery highlights both the promise and challenges of identifying very wide, low-mass companions through microlensing. Although upcoming facilities such as Roman and Earth 2.0 space telescopes will improve sensitivity to such events, overcoming degeneracies and distinguishing them from variable phenomena will remain essential for building a robust statistical sample.

artifacts.abstract_zh: 为了搜寻极宽轨道的双透镜事件，我们对OGLE-IV和KMTNet在2011年至2024年间探测到的微引力透镜事件进行了交叉匹配。在排除了变星的污染后，我们确认OGLE-2016-BLG-0523是一个微引力透镜事件，其光变曲线显示出两个短寿命的隆起，两者相隔8.36年。我们研究了三种解释这两个隆起的方案，包括双透镜单源（2L1S）、单透镜双源（1L2S）以及两个不相关的单透镜单源事件（2$\times$1L1S）。1L2S解释因对数据的拟合较差而被排除，而2$\times$1L1S方案则因事件率低、总源流量不物理以及两个假定源中一个的颜色不物理而不被支持。对于幸存的2L1S解释，两个隆起的爱因斯坦时间尺度分别为$8.343 \pm 0.076$天和$3.231 \pm 0.047$天，意味着双星质量比$q = 0.15$。贝叶斯分析表明主透镜最可能是一颗低质量M矮星，而伴星可能是一颗低质量褐矮星或超级木星。推断的投影分离约为450 au，使得该伴星成为迄今通过微引力透镜发现的最宽低质量天体。我们的发现凸显了通过微引力透镜识别极宽低质量伴星的前景和挑战。尽管Roman和Earth 2.0空间望远镜等即将到来的设施将提高对此类事件的灵敏度，但克服简并并区分它们与变星现象对于构建稳健的统计样本仍然至关重要。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于可用的摘要，该伴星是迄今微引力透镜发现的最宽低质量天体；研究既显示搜寻极宽低质量伴星的前景，也揭示其挑战。Roman与Earth 2.0等未来设施将提升灵敏度，但克服简并、区分变星现象仍是构建稳健统计样本的关键。

The upper panel displays the full light curve from 2010 to 2025, while the lower panels zoom in on the two events in 2016 and 2024 with their residuals. figures.caption_en: Figure 2: Color-magnitude diagram for OGLE-2016-BLG-0523. Black dots show OGLE-III field stars [ 47 ] within \(1.5^{\prime}\) of the event position. The red asterisk marks the red-clump centroid. The blue dot and triangle indicate the primary and secondary sources of the 1L2S model, respectively, while the magenta dot and triangle indicate the corresponding sources of the 2 \(\times\) 1L1S model. Green points show the HST CMD from [ 27 ] , with the HST red-clump centroid shifted to match the OGLE-III red clump. The red line represents the red boundary of bulge main-sequence stars derived from stellar isochrones with [M/H] = \(+0.5\) and an age of 5 Gyr.
